job.title: Software Development Engineer, Agentic AI (Velocity Labs)
job.pay_full: $143,700 – $194,400 a year base salary (Seattle), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: Velocity Labs is an AWS team set up to move fast on agentic AI: it experiments with new ideas, ships early products quickly and keeps AWS at the leading edge. Its engineers build the foundational AI services customers use to transform their businesses, alongside applied scientists, ML practitioners and solution architects.
duties: Design and build AI primitives and customer-facing services in a fast-moving team
Take features from concept and design through implementation, roll-out and support
Create and review system designs and build services with the team
Follow software engineering best practices to keep schedules on track and quality high
Join the planning and brainstorming that shapes the products' direction
Use AI-enabled tooling throughout the product lifecycle
needs: 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
2+ years designing or architecting new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability, scaling)
1+ years as a software development engineer or in a related occupation
1+ years building large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software in C#, C++, Java or Perl
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field
nice: 3+ years across the full software development life cycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing and operations
details.benefits: Base salary $143,700 – $194,400 a year (Seattle). The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Amazon offers workplace accommodations during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
